title.en: As Long as There Is Light

choir.name: Il paese
choir.voice: the mixed choir of the village

lines.it: Pietra su pietra, mani nel vento,
lines.id: Batu demi batu, tangan di tengah angin,
lines.en: Stone upon stone, our hands in the wind,

lines.it: alzammo la torre sopra lo scoglio.
lines.id: kami dirikan menara di atas karang.
lines.en: we raised the tower on the rock.

lines.it: Ogni inverno il mare prendeva un figlio,
lines.id: Setiap musim dingin laut mengambil seorang anak,
lines.en: Every winter the sea took a son,

lines.it: e noi giurammo: mai più nel buio.
lines.id: dan kami bersumpah: tak lagi dalam gelap.
lines.en: and we swore: never again in the dark.

lines.it: Io portavo l'acqua, il pane, la calce,
lines.id: Aku membawa air, roti, dan kapur,
lines.en: I carried the water, the bread, the lime,

lines.it: tu cantavi piano contro il freddo.
lines.en: you sang softly against the cold.

lines.it: Nostro figlio dormiva in una cesta di corda
lines.id: Anak kita tidur dalam keranjang tali
lines.en: Our son slept in a basket of rope

lines.id: di bawah nyala api yang pertama.
lines.en: beneath the first flame we lit.
Turn the lantern
watch the sea...
As long as there is light
come home!
as long as there is light
I stay here
Above the black sea
I turn the wheel
as long as there is light...
come home!

lines.it: Nino è cresciuto, ha le tue spalle,
lines.id: Nino sudah besar, bahunya seperti bahumu,
lines.en: Nino has grown, he has your shoulders,

lines.it: ha il sale negli occhi e il mare nel petto.
lines.id: garam di matanya, laut di dadanya.
lines.en: salt in his eyes and the sea in his chest.

lines.it: Ogni alba lo guardo partire con gli altri
lines.id: Setiap fajar kulihat ia berangkat bersama yang lain
lines.en: Every dawn I watch him leave with the others

lines.it: e conto le vele, una per una.
lines.id: dan kuhitung layarnya, satu demi satu.
lines.en: and I count the sails, one by one.

lines.it: Pulisco il vetro, carico i pesi,
lines.en: I clean the glass, I wind the weights,

lines.it: la catena scende tutta la notte.
lines.en: the chain goes down the whole night long.

lines.it: Se la luce si ferma, il mare non perdona,
lines.id: Jika cahaya berhenti, laut tak memaafkan,
lines.en: If the light stops, the sea does not forgive,

lines.it: lo so da quando ero bambino.
lines.id: aku tahu sejak aku masih kecil.
lines.en: I have known it since I was a boy.
Turn the lantern
watch the sea...
As long as there is light
come home!
as long as there is light
I stay here
Above the black sea
I turn the wheel
as long as there is light...
come home!

lines.it: Notte di tempesta, la catena si spezza!
lines.en: A night of storm, the chain snaps!
Turn, turn, turn!

lines.it: Le mani sulla ruota, Lucia porta l'olio!
lines.id: Tangan di roda, Lucia membawa minyak!
lines.en: Hands on the wheel, Lucia brings the oil!
Turn, turn, turn!

lines.it: Una vela, due vele, dieci vele tornano,
lines.id: Satu layar, dua layar, sepuluh layar kembali,
lines.en: One sail, two sails, ten sails come home,

lines.it: ma la vela di Nino non si vede.
lines.en: but Nino's sail is nowhere to be seen.

lines.it: All'alba il mare ha riportato la sua barca,
lines.en: At dawn the sea brought back his boat,
empty and light upon the sand.
As long as there is light,
come home!
someone else's son,
I stay here.
Even though mine
will never come home,
as long as there is light...
come home!
As long as there is light,
come home!
as long as there is light,
I stay here...
Light it, Matteo. It is evening.
